findings.claim: Industry commentary (TrendForce-sourced analysis) describes the current CoWoS/advanced-packaging and HBM capacity shortage as structural rather than temporary; TSMC's CoWoS capacity is expanding at roughly an 80% CAGR (from ~80,000 WPM toward 120,000-130,000 WPM through 2026, and over 60% higher by 2027) but demand is still outpacing supply, with the shortage expected to ease only slightly by 2027.
findings.source: TrendForce press release (via Fusion WW summary), "Inside the AI Bottleneck: CoWoS, HBM, and 2-3nm Capacity Constraints Through 2027"

findings.claim: Camtek CEO Rafi Amit stated the company has received orders and forecasts from two HBM manufacturers for 3D metrology and 2D inspection steps representing expected revenue exceeding $260 million for 2026 and 2027 combined, and characterized the HBM4 generation transition as more metrology-intensive than prior HBM generations, a structural (not one-off) demand driver for Camtek's inspection/metrology tools.
findings.source: Camtek Q2 2026 earnings call commentary (Barchart, "Camtek's Metrology Dominance in Advanced Packaging Hits Its First Real Demand Test"; Kavout market-lens summary)

findings.claim: Camtek has received more than $600 million in orders since the start of 2026, with deliveries scheduled through the remainder of 2026 and into 2027, and about 75% of Q2 2026 revenue came from advanced packaging (primarily AI-related).
findings.source: Camtek Q2 2026 earnings call highlights (Yahoo Finance)

findings.claim: SEMI forecasts global semiconductor equipment sales reaching a record $156 billion in 2027 and $229 billion in 2028, driven primarily by AI-related investment in leading-edge logic, HBM memory, and advanced packaging; assembly and packaging equipment specifically is forecast to reach $8.6 billion by 2028, with test equipment sales up 48.1% in 2025 to $11.2 billion as the back-end segment recovers faster than front-end fabrication.
findings.source: SEMI press release, "Global Semiconductor Equipment Sales Forecast to Reach a Record $229 Billion in 2028"

findings.claim: The global semiconductor metrology and inspection equipment market (Yole Group data) exceeded $18 billion and grew 15% in 2025, accounting for ~14% of total wafer fab equipment spend, driven by AI/HBM/advanced packaging; the 3D HBM memory-stacking inspection & metrology sub-segment reached ~$230.4 million in 2025 (25.9% of a related market) with a projected ~10.1% CAGR.
findings.source: Electronics Weekly, "Metrology and inspection equipment market tops $18bn" (citing Yole Group)

findings.claim: In the broader metrology/inspection equipment market, KLA is the dominant broad-based platform (its share of the global metrology and inspection equipment market rose from 55.0% in 2020 to 64.1% in 2025), while Camtek is characterized as providing the most concentrated pure-play exposure to advanced-packaging inspection specifically, competing against larger-scale rivals (KLA, Onto Innovation) that have greater R&D budgets.
findings.source: Dr. Robert Castellano Substack, "KLA, Camtek, and Nova: Three Ways to Invest in Rising Process-Control Intensity"

rows.text: HBM4 supercycle 2026-28 兌現，Camtek 維持 ≥ 60% 2D inspection + 80% 3D metrology HBM 市佔（reference tool 地位）

columns.2Y 驗證點（具體數字門檻）: 2026Q3/Q4 HBM4 mfr 採購分配公告：Camtek 拿 ≥ 60% 2D + ≥ 80% 3D；$260M backlog through 2027 兌現率 ≥ 95%
columns.5Y 驗證點: HBM4E（2028-30）延續 + Camtek 拿下 ≥ 50% 2D 市佔；HBM 業務 Rev FY28 ≥ $400M
columns.資料來源: HBM mfr 法說 capex 結構（SK Hynix Q4/Q1 法說、Samsung memory 部門、Micron HBM disclosures）、Camtek Q1/Q3 法說 HBM 佔比、Hawk 出貨 unit count
columns.漂移觸發條件（QC-34 季節性過濾）: 連 2 季 HBM 業務 Rev YoY < +10% = 削弱訊號；單季偏離不觸發（避免 ramp 不均季節性誤判）

rows.text: CoWoS 外包 OSAT 持續擴張，Camtek 50% OSAT 滲透維持（FY26 OSAT 全球 wafers 達 240-270K，CAMT OSAT Rev YoY ≥ +20%）

columns.2Y 驗證點（具體數字門檻）: 2026 ASE/Amkor capex +30% YoY，Camtek OSAT Rev FY26 ≥ $180M（vs FY25 $150M）；Q2/Q3 法說 OSAT bookings 持續創高
columns.5Y 驗證點: OSAT CoWoS 全球 wafers 從 2026 240-270K → 2028 400K+；Camtek OSAT Rev 翻倍至 $300M+
columns.資料來源: ASE 法說 capex、Amkor capex disclosure、TSMC CoWoS 外包 wafers 數據（TSMC Q3 法說常 disclose 外包比例）、SPIL/Powertech 順序
columns.漂移觸發條件（QC-34 季節性過濾）: 連 2 季 OSAT Rev YoY < +10% = 削弱；OSAT capex 預算 cut ≥ 15% YoY = 警戒

rows.text: 估值於 H2 2026 因 ONTO 競爭壓力 + 數據波動回測至 FPE NTM 35x（≈ $122）

columns.2Y 驗證點（具體數字門檻）: Q2/Q3 26 guidance miss / hit；5Y Fwd PE 分位回到 ≤ 70%；ONTO G5 是否拿下第二家 HBM mfr
columns.5Y 驗證點: 5Y 進入 HBM4E 順利兌現，FPE 回到 5Y 中位 25-28x 區間
columns.資料來源: Fwd PE 軌跡（yfinance forwardPE）、PEG（FactSet/Refinitiv 共識）、ONTO 季法說競爭新聞、SOX 走勢
columns.漂移觸發條件（QC-34 季節性過濾）: 連 2 個月股價突破 $200 = 估值修復路徑延後；單日波動不觸發

rows.text: ONTO Dragonfly G5 拿下第二家 Tier-1 HBM 主供（已 1 家 + 2D + 3Di + $240M VPA）

columns.監測指標: HBM mfr 法說採購、ONTO Q2/Q3 法說新客戶公告、Hawk 平台 Q3/Q4 訂單水位
columns.警戒閾值: 第二家 Tier-1 主供切換 = QC-23 🔴 護城河 −1 至 8/10，B 級警戒，訊號重評至 C/X；應對速度：中期 — 不需 panic 但需 12 個月內準備 trim plan

rows.text: OSAT CoWoS capex 不如預期，TSMC 內部消化大部分

columns.監測指標: ASE/Amkor capex 季報、TSMC 外包 wafers 實際交付（指引 240-270K）
columns.警戒閾值: OSAT 外包 < 200K wafers/年 = 警戒；應對速度：短期 — capex cut 訊號出現後 1-2 季內看到 Rev 影響

rows.text: HBM5 / CoPoS 過渡期讓 Camtek 設備過時（管理層執行力 + 技術領先風險）

columns.時間尺度: 🐢 長期結構（2+ 年慢變數）
columns.監測指標: HBM5 規格 timeline（2029-30）、CoPoS 啟動進度、Camtek 下一代平台
columns.警戒閾值: HBM5/CoPoS 量產時 Camtek 無 reference 提案 = 結構性 thesis 反轉；應對速度：長期 — 結構慢變數，需 2-3 年 lead time monitor，不會單季觸發

items.claim: 管理層給出第二季營收指引區間為1.29億至1.31億美元。
items.speaker: Rafi Amit (CEO)

items.claim: 管理層預期下半年營收將較上半年成長逾25%。
items.quote: over 25% higher revenues compared with the first half
items.speaker: Rafi Amit (CEO)

items.claim: 分析師追問HBM訂單在26/27年如何分配，CFO回應今年已有可觀出貨量、其餘落在2027年。
items.quote: There is a significant number already for '26 shipments
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg (CFO)

items.claim: 管理層公布第一季毛利率為51%。
items.quote: The gross margin for the quarter was 51%
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg (CFO)

items.claim: CFO預期下半年毛利率將改善。
items.quote: gross margin to improve in the second half of the year
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg (CFO)

items.claim: CFO預期下半年營業利益率將回到約30%水準。
items.quote: operating margin to return to around 30% level
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg (CFO)

items.claim: 管理層說明已收到兩家HBM廠商訂單與預測，對應2026-2027年營收超過2.6億美元。
items.quote: exceeding the amount of $260 million for 2026 and 2027
items.speaker: Rafi Amit (CEO)

items.claim: 管理層表示新AI能力預期將使2027年可服務市場規模擴大至逾20億美元。
items.quote: total addressable market to over $2 billion in 2027
items.speaker: Rafi Amit (CEO)

items.claim: 管理層預期Eagle G5與Hawk平台營收將在2026年翻倍。
items.quote: we expect revenue from this platform to double in 2026
items.speaker: Rafi Amit (CEO)

items.claim: 管理層宣布已完成收購Visual Layer交易並開始整合其技術。
items.quote: we have managed to close this transaction
items.speaker: Rafi Amit (CEO)

items.claim: 管理層表示中國市場中僅有一家具意義的當地競爭者。
items.quote: only one meaningful player that really competes with us
items.speaker: Ramy Langer (COO)

items.claim: 針對2026年成長率是否落後同業的提問，管理層明確否認正在流失市占率。
items.quote: we are losing market share, the answer is absolutely no
items.speaker: Ramy Langer (COO)

items.claim: 管理層表示儘管中東情勢艱難，公司過去數月未曾錯過任何一次出貨。
items.quote: not missed even one shipment throughout the entire few
items.speaker: Ramy Langer (COO)

items.claim: 管理層表示正在德國擴充產能，作為以色列以外據點的持續布局。
items.quote: we are going to add capacity in Germany
items.speaker: Ramy Langer (COO)

items.claim: 被問及美國與台灣兩家chiplet客戶的份額時，管理層表示在兩家客戶皆維持強勢地位。
items.quote: We have a strong position in both customers.
items.speaker: Ramy Langer (COO)

items.claim: 管理層表示公司已備妥並持續增加庫存，以因應客戶任何規模的訂單需求。
items.quote: we have enough inventory and we are ramping the inventory
items.speaker: Ramy Langer (COO)
